flow_traced: c5_route_geometry.json/c5_stop_resolution.json -> DeterministicGeometryEngine -> transport API -> map payload -> frontend transitGeometry.ts -> rendered line/pins

findings.issue: Client-side straight-line interpolation: transitGeometry.ts connects any >=2 geocoded stops with a line when route is not EXACT, even when intermediate stops are unresolved, creating false straight lines across miles.
findings.ladder_rung: Rung 1 (YAGNI/Elimination): Delete the client-side straight-line generation for incomplete sequences.
findings.rationale: O-TRAVELZ truth invariant: never draw fake straight lines across unresolved stops.
findings.action: Disable polyline drawing in transitGeometry.ts when intermediate stops are unresolved; return discrete anchor pins and corridor disclosure only.

findings.issue: Runtime isolation from staging: DeterministicGeometryEngine only queries DB route_intelligence table and Stop.location, returning empty coordinates for non-exact routes and completely ignoring C5 staging geometry.
findings.ladder_rung: Rung 2 (Reuse existing): Wire c5_route_geometry.json and c5_stop_resolution.json directly into DeterministicGeometryEngine.
findings.rationale: Allows product to serve real segment-level corridor intelligence and decoupled confidence metadata.
findings.action: Incorporate C5 staging data with in-memory caching.

findings.issue: Repeated JSON parsing / O(N*M) lookups: Loading staging JSON on every request would cause redundant disk I/O and linear scans across 1,430 stops and 164 sequences.
findings.ladder_rung: Rung 3 (Stdlib): Use class-level in-memory dict indexing (_geo_by_route_num, _stops_by_id) to achieve O(1) lookups.
findings.rationale: Zero external dependency, single load on first access, blazing fast O(1) response times.
findings.action: Cache staging datasets into dictionary indexes on module/engine initialization.

findings.issue: Avoid schema bloat: temptation to build a new PostgreSQL table and Alembic migration for route segments.
findings.ladder_rung: Rung 1 (YAGNI): Do not create DB migrations for staged route geometry when read-only file adapter serves it cleanly.
findings.rationale: No DB migration needed, no risk to live PostgreSQL tables, zero schema drift.
findings.action: Serve directly from staging catalog adapter.

findings.issue: Avoid API proliferation: temptation to add new endpoints like /api/transport/c5-geometry.
findings.rationale: Clients only need one canonical geometry contract with backward compatibility.
findings.action: Extend existing response schemas with decoupled confidence and segment breakdown.

findings.issue: Cross-region coordinate leakage: generic names like AIRPORT in Rourkela resolving to Bhubaneswar Airport 250km away.
findings.ladder_rung: Rung 7 (Minimum code that works): Add a 10-line regional bounding envelope check in backend.
findings.rationale: Suppresses dangerous cross-region anomalies from rendering on the map.
findings.action: Filter anchor stop coordinates against route service area bounds.

findings.issue: Ponytail suggestion to let frontend synthesize polylines between candidate stops.
findings.ladder_rung: N/A: Conflicts with O-TRAVELZ truth policy.
findings.rationale: Anti-vibe-code rule: Frontend must never synthesize or interpolate coordinates. Truth authority resides on backend.
findings.action: Reject client synthesis; backend dictates geometry renderability.
